# JointContrastiveClassification

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A learning framework that simultaneously optimizes contrastive and classification objectives to improve cross-domain generalization in optical networks. Enables models to learn domain-invariant representations, critical for adapting TCC/iNEST systems to varying network topologies and conditions.
